title: 1.4 IT for Entrepreneurship
description: Entrepreneurship, IT-enabled businesses, job creation and SMEs

questions.question: What is entrepreneurship?
options: The process of paying taxes only
The process of closing an existing business
The process of designing, launching, and running a new business
The process of memorizing business terms
questions.correctAnswer: The process of designing, launching, and running a new business

questions.question: Who is an entrepreneur?
options: An individual who invests in foreign markets only
An individual who only works for a salary
An individual who creates a new business, bearing most of the risks and enjoying most of the rewards
An individual who avoids taking any risk
questions.correctAnswer: An individual who creates a new business, bearing most of the risks and enjoying most of the rewards

questions.question: The entrepreneur is commonly seen as which of the following?
options: A customer who buys products online
An innovator, a source of new ideas, goods, services, and businesses
A clerk who records daily sales
questions.correctAnswer: An innovator, a source of new ideas, goods, services, and businesses

questions.question: What does information technology (IT) do to the world of work?
options: IT is removing jobs from the economy
IT is transforming the world of work
IT is ending all business activities
IT is limiting business to local areas
questions.correctAnswer: IT is transforming the world of work

questions.question: What is an IT-enabled business?
options: A business that avoids using computers
A business that uses IT as a platform to run a business
A business that works without any technology
A business that sells farm products only
questions.correctAnswer: A business that uses IT as a platform to run a business

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of an IT-enabled business?
options: Online training, providing data entry and processing services, Internet Cafe service, and online product sells
questions.correctAnswer: Online training, providing data entry and processing services, Internet Cafe service, and online product sells

questions.question: IT-enabled businesses are providing new opportunities for what?
options: Job creation that could help tackle global unemployment
Moving jobs out of the country
questions.correctAnswer: Job creation that could help tackle global unemployment

questions.question: The development of mobile-based applications has created new opportunities for which group?
options: Small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in various parts of the world
questions.correctAnswer: Small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in various parts of the world

questions.question: The text mentions which countries as examples where SMEs gained new opportunities from mobile-based applications?
questions.correctAnswer: India and Kenya

questions.question: According to the text, youth unemployment is described as what?
options: A problem that has been fully solved
One of the global challenges we face today
A problem that IT cannot address
questions.correctAnswer: One of the global challenges we face today

questions.question: Which of the following is a key reason IT should be included in youth employment and entrepreneurship strategies?
options: IT reduces the number of startups
More jobs and businesses require IT skills
IT removes the need for education
questions.correctAnswer: More jobs and businesses require IT skills

questions.question: According to the text, there is an explosion of online learning opportunities and resources for whom?
questions.correctAnswer: Job seekers and digital entrepreneurs

questions.question: People who are competent in IT can have their own business in which roles?
options: Application developers, game developers, and service providers
questions.correctAnswer: Application developers, game developers, and service providers

questions.question: IT-based service providers can run their businesses using various platforms including which of the following?
questions.correctAnswer: Social network websites

questions.question: In Ethiopia, which IT-based services are flourishing?
questions.correctAnswer: Internet cafes and online sales

questions.question: Compared with traditional businesses, starting an IT-based business requires less of which of the following?
questions.correctAnswer: Large capital

questions.question: What can an innovative and entrepreneurial mind with little resource like a laptop create?
questions.correctAnswer: Incredible business ideas

questions.question: Who is the founder of RIDE mentioned in the text?
questions.correctAnswer: Samrawit Fikru

questions.question: RIDE started as what kind of service?
questions.correctAnswer: An SMS-based service

questions.question: What is RIDE today?
options: A popular Internet-based taxi-hailing service used by thousands of people
questions.correctAnswer: A popular Internet-based taxi-hailing service used by thousands of people

questions.question: Which of the following is a contribution of RIDE?
options: Job creation in addition to providing an alternative service to taxi users
Reducing the number of available taxis
questions.correctAnswer: Job creation in addition to providing an alternative service to taxi users

questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit of ICT entrepreneurship?
questions.correctAnswer: All of the above

questions.question: What does information technology (IT) provide for business people?
questions.correctAnswer: New opportunities

questions.question: Which of the following describes how IT is transforming youth entrepreneurship?
options: IT blocks young people from new markets
IT is transforming the way young digital entrepreneurs do business
IT limits young businesses to local buyers
questions.correctAnswer: IT is transforming the way young digital entrepreneurs do business
